# A grid's centre group row resets to the origin when it re-projects after a scroll

## Context

`test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderGroups.spec.mjs:224` fails intermittently on hosted CI. On Engine PR #20494, run 42307988793 (job 128202192920) at 81ce12b8:
- the leaves reached the new scroll position (the `toPass()` at :217–220 passed);
- the centre group cells then stayed misaligned for the full 5 s;
- a same-head retry was green.

That PR's change cannot reach the grid header. The defect-note (fingerprint `8b0774ab`, 2026-11-06 23:20Z) is promoted here because the failure recurred after #20466. **Unknown:** what triggered the re-projection inside the CI run (a column-position or width update is the likely source, not observed).

## The Problem

Reproduced on `examples/grid/headerGroups` under CPU throttling (`Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate` 8–10×): 4 of 6, and later 4 of 10, runs stuck. A `scrollLeft` setter probe on `.neo-grid-header-group-part-center` recorded the same sequence in every stuck run:
1. two writes of 300 from the scroll sync;
2. a write of `undefined` from `DeltaUpdates.updateNode` (`src/main/DeltaUpdates.mjs:928`), called from `Main.renderFrame`, which the browser applies as 0.

The part stayed the same DOM node throughout. The leaf header stayed at 300, and the part could have scrolled up to 942 px, so the value was reset, not clamped.

## The Architectural Reality

- `GridHorizontalScrollSync.onScroll` copies the scrollbar's position onto the centre group part (`src/main/addon/GridHorizontalScrollSync.mjs:83`).
- That scroll reaches the App worker. `GroupRow` captures it, because `saveScrollPosition` defaults to true (`src/component/Abstract.mjs:113`), and `onScrollCapture` records `scrollLeft` on the part in its vdom (`src/component/Base.mjs:1843`) and vnode (`Abstract.mjs:533`), "preserved for future re-renders".
- `GroupRow#project()` rebuilds `vdom.cn` from scratch (`src/grid/header/GroupRow.mjs:74`), so a re-projection after the scroll drops the recorded value. The vdom diff then emits `scrollLeft: undefined` for the part (`src/vdom/Helper.mjs:138–141` emits whenever new and old differ), and `DeltaUpdates` writes it.
- `#aligned` re-applies the header's position only for the first projection (`GroupRow.mjs:121`), so nothing restores the part afterwards.

## The Fix

In `GroupRow#project()`, carry each part's recorded `scrollLeft` from the previous `vdom.cn` into the rebuilt part, keyed by part id. A re-projection then diffs no scroll change.

The unit test goes in `test/playwright/unit/grid/HeaderGroups.spec.mjs`: record a centre-part scroll through `onScrollCapture`, re-project and update, then assert that the part's vdom and vnode still hold the value.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] After a recorded centre-part scroll, a re-projection keeps that `scrollLeft` in the part's vdom and vnode. The unit test fails without the fix (`Expected: 300, Received: undefined`).
- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/grid/HeaderGroups.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderGroups.spec.mjs` pass at the PR head, and the e2e scroll test passes repeated under CPU throttling.
- [ ] Post-merge: no recurrence of `HeaderGroups.spec.mjs:224` on hosted CI (the defect-note stays closed).

## Out of Scope

- Making the vdom diff (`Helper.mjs`) ignore an `undefined` scroll value engine-wide. That would cover every component that rebuilds a scrolled node, but it changes every component's diff on the weekend of the 13.4 cut. It's a separate decision.
- The other HeaderGroups tests, and the scroll sync addon's handling of a clamped header.

## Avoided Traps

- **The clamp hypothesis** (my first read, in the defect-note): the part was never clamped. The probe measured `scrollLeft` 0 against a 942 px range.
- **Re-aligning on every projection** with `DomAccess.scrollTo` and the App-side header `scrollLeft`: that value can lag the main thread, so it would pull the part back to an older position.
